title: VendPoint Placement Agreement — Number of Machines and the Ship-To Requirement
content:
**Clause 1 — Number of machines.** Under the VendPoint Industrial Vending Program a customer may hold any number of VendPoint machines, including several at one ship-to; each machine is a separate placement with its own model tier, minimum term and fees. The program sets no maximum number of machines per customer.

**Clause 2 — Ship-to requirement.** A machine is requested only for a ship-to whose status is active.

### How the clauses apply

| Situation | Under the clauses |
|---|---|
| A customer already holding one machine requests another | Clause 1 sets no maximum; the new request is a separate placement with its own model tier, minimum term and fees |
| Two machines stand at the same ship-to | Each remains a separate placement; neither shares the other's minimum term or fees under Clause 1 |
| The ship-to named on a request has a status other than active | Clause 2 is not met: a machine is requested only for an active ship-to |

### Evidence

The status that decides Clause 2 is the status of that ship-to as the company's Ship-To Fulfillment Account record shows it before the request is recorded, for the same ship-to the request names; the system record is the authority, not a description of the site.
